On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. Shares are this community’s count divided by the North Delta total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Condo buildings in Sunshine Hills Woods
Scott & Nicholson — 6950 and 6960 Nicholson Road

A two-address apartment development at the Delta–Surrey border below 72 Avenue; a current listing describes it as a 188-unit development with a clubhouse (kitchen, party room), exercise centre and playground, and unit listings describe 12,000 sq ft of amenities including a gas firepit lounge/dining area, gym, clubhouse and BBQs, with underground parking and a storage locker per unit. A unit listing records cats OK for that unit — listing data for one unit, not a verified building bylaw summary; building-wide pet/rental/age restrictions are otherwise not confirmed from public sources. Year-built conflict: listings give 2021 for most units at both addresses, 2022 for several 6960 units, and 2023 for one 6950 penthouse unit — consistent with phased completion, but the exact per-building year is not confirmed, sources differ (2021–2023).
Village at Sunshine Hills — 11996 70 Avenue (presale-stage in the sources checked)

A presale directory (secondary source) describes a 6-storey woodframe mixed-use building by JPS Developments at 70 Avenue and Scott Road, with 90 condominiums (1- to 3-bedroom, 476–940 sq ft, 20 of them adaptable), 8,458 sq ft of ground-floor commercial space, three levels of underground parking for 144 vehicles, a rooftop deck, dog run and children's play area, and each home including one parking stall and one bike locker (two stalls for 3-bedroom units). Restrictions: Not confirmed (no disclosure statement was read).
Streets, schools and getting around Sunshine Hills Woods

items.t: Where the condo stock concentrates: the south-east corner against Scott Road, south of 72 Avenue — Scott & Nicholson at 6950/6960 Nicholson Road, and the Village at Sunshine Hills project at 11996 70 Avenue (70 Avenue and Scott Road). The detached interior around Watershed Park and Cougar Canyon has no apartment condo buildings confirmed.

Green anchors: Watershed Park at 11600 Kittson Parkway is described by the City as Delta's largest park, with eleven kilometres of gravel trails; Cougar Canyon Environmental Reserve is at 11300 72 Avenue.

Transit runs on the edges, not the interior: route 340 via Scott Road, 64 Avenue and Kittson Parkway; route 364 along the south edge; route 319 along 72 Avenue at the north edge; and the R6 RapidBus on Scott Road at the east side.

blocks.text: Good to know about Sunshine Hills Woods

items.t: The condo corner is a different neighbourhood in practice: Scott & Nicholson listings market walk-to access to Scottsdale Centre, Cougar Canyon and Seaquam Secondary, and the Village at Sunshine Hills directory places Scottsdale Centre mall — Save-On-Foods, Walmart Supercentre, Dollarama, BC Liquor — directly across 70 Avenue. The detached interior's amenity is Watershed Park; the condo corner's amenity is the mall and Scott Road transit.

Village at Sunshine Hills is mixed-use, not pure residential: its directory entry lists 8,458 sq ft of ground-floor commercial space and three underground parking levels for 144 vehicles serving 90 homes — the commercial component means section cost-sharing and retail-neighbour questions belong in the disclosure-statement read.

Scott & Nicholson also contains townhome-form units: at least one current listing at 6950 Nicholson Road is for a 2-level townhome unit inside the same development name — as with Muse in Annieville, the complex name alone does not tell a buyer the unit's form.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Sunshine Hills Woods
Chelsea Gate — 11188 72 Avenue. Strata (freehold strata)

A townhouse complex on the 72 Avenue corridor: a presale directory (secondary source) describes 60 woodframe townhomes by Westcorp Developments, 3- and 4-bedroom Tudor-style homes beside Cougar Creek, and a current listing records Title to Land: Freehold Strata for its units, classified Townhouse in Sunshine Hills Woods, with a clubhouse, gym/exercise centre and playground in complex amenity records. Year built: listings record 2018 and 2019 for different units — carried as 2018–2019, phased in listing terms; confirm the unit's year on the strata plan. Published rental/pet/age restrictions: Not confirmed from the sources checked.
Cyrus Hill — 7167 116 Street. Strata

A townhouse complex just south of 72 Avenue: a presale directory (secondary source) describes 40 woodframe townhomes by Bassi Properties, 3- and 4-bedroom homes, with maintenance fees carried in the project record (fees TBA at presale) — a strata project record; current listings classify its units as Townhouse in Sunshine Hills Woods with strata-style management/maintenance amenity records. Year built — conflict in secondary sources: MLS listings consistently record 2021, while the presale record gave an expected completion of Fall/Winter 2019 and one secondary project page states completion in 2019 — carried as completed stock trading as resales, year 2021 per MLS listings, with the 2019 completion claim flagged not confirmed. Published rental/pet/age restrictions: Not confirmed from the sources checked; confirm title and bylaws on the Form B.
Sunshine Woods — 6300 Cottonwood Street. Strata

The sub-area's oldest verified townhouse complex: a building directory (secondary source) records it built 1989 with 12 units. The same directory records its restriction as "rentals not allowed" — that rental line is void for long-term rentals since November 24, 2022, flagged here in-entry. Published pet/age restrictions beyond that directory line: Not confirmed.
Nicholson Green — 6866 Nicholson Road. Strata — mixed-form complex, townhouse units counted with the caveat stated
A gated complex built 1991 (listings) in the Nicholson Road pocket, with a clubhouse in listing amenity records. Unit count and published rental/pet/age restrictions: Not confirmed.
Streets, schools and getting around Sunshine Hills Woods

items.t: The City publishes no street-by-street written boundary for either neighbourhood; the working grid used in research is 72 Avenue north, 64 Avenue south, Watershed Park and Lyon Road west, Scott Road (120 Street) east — a working grid, not an official boundary.

Where the townhouse stock concentrates: the edges, not the park interior — the 72 Avenue corridor at the north edge (Chelsea Gate, 11188 72 Avenue; Cyrus Hill, 7167 116 Street just south of 72nd) and the Nicholson Road pocket at the south-east against Scott Road (Sunshine Woods, 6300 Cottonwood Street; Nicholson Green, 6866 Nicholson Road). The detached interior around Watershed Park and Cougar Canyon has no townhouse complex confirmed.

Green anchors: Watershed Park, 11600 Kittson Pkwy, is described by the City as Delta's largest park, with eleven kilometres of gravel trails; Cougar Canyon Environmental Reserve is at 11300 72 Ave and Westview Park at 6500 Westview Dr. Cougar Creek is a salmon-bearing watercourse running through Surrey and Delta, with City bank-stabilization work in Cougar Canyon; streamside setback detail is lot-specific.

Transit runs on the edges: route 340 runs Scottsdale Exchange to 22nd Street Station via Scott Road, 64 Avenue, Kittson Parkway, Highway 91 and the Alex Fraser Bridge, through the Watershed Park edge; route 364 runs Langley Centre to Scottsdale Exchange via 64 Avenue and Scott Road along the south edge; route 319 runs Scott Road Station to Newton Exchange via 72 Avenue along the north edge; the R6 RapidBus runs on Scott Road at the east side. Highway 91 access is via 64 Avenue.
Listings for the Nicholson Road pocket name Cougar Canyon Elementary and Seaquam Secondary — the elementary result differs by address, so every address must be run in the locator.

Library and recreation: George Mackie Library (Fraser Valley Regional Library), 8440 112th Street, is north of the area in Nordel; no recreation centre inside the working grid was confirmed — the North Delta Recreation Centre at 11415 84 Avenue serves North Delta. The nearest hospital is Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, in Ladner; the North Delta Public Health Unit is at 11245 84 Avenue.

Property tax and utilities: City of Delta 2026 property taxes were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on balances outstanding after July 2, 2026 and a further 5% after September 2, 2026; Delta's 2026 flat-rate utility fee is $1,658 for a single-family home.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Sunshine Hills Woods

items.t: Streamside rules: Cougar Creek is a salmon-bearing watercourse, and any property within 30 m of a stream falls in Delta's Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area, which can limit additions and rebuilds — directly relevant to Chelsea Gate, whose presale record places it alongside Cougar Creek, and to canyon-side lots generally.

blocks.text: Good to know about Sunshine Hills Woods

items.t: Two of this sub-area's seven candidate townhouse names cannot be verified on any citable source.

A City corridor report (LU009876) covers proposed 72 Avenue corridor pre-zoning and confirms townhouse projects have been built along the corridor under the Mixed Residential designation — Chelsea Gate and Cyrus Hill sit in exactly that corridor, while the Watershed Park interior stays detached.

The Nicholson Road pocket is a different daily life from the park interior. The townhouse and condo pocket at Nicholson Road markets walk-to access to the Scott Road shopping node (Scottsdale Centre across 70 Avenue in the Village at Sunshine Hills directory: Save-On-Foods, Walmart Supercentre, Dollarama, BC Liquor) and Scott Road transit, while the interior's amenity is Watershed Park's eleven kilometres of gravel trails. Same sub-area label, two different products.

A co-op hides in the townhouse pocket. Cougar Canyon Housing Co-operative (6800–6846 Nicholson Road, 18 units) sits in the same Nicholson corridor as the strata complexes, states "No age requirement" in the City guide, and is family co-op housing — a search that treats every attached complex on Nicholson Road as a strata townhouse will mis-describe it.
The sub-area name itself is two neighbourhoods. Verify by address, not by the label.

Delta's flat-rate utility fee is a line item house buyers forget. The City's 2026 flat-rate utility fee is $1,658 for a single-family home — a fixed annual cost that sits outside both strata fees and property tax for the detached streets around these complexes.

blocks.text: Sunshine Hills Woods home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

16 townhomes sold in Sunshine Hills Woods with a median price of $743,500 (the middle half sold between $636,750 and $930,000), taking a median of 32 days to sell at 97.0% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $478 per square foot, a median year built of 1988 and a median strata fee of $476 a month. 6 condos sold in Sunshine Hills Woods with a median price of $582,500, taking a median of 46 days to sell at 95.4% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $635 per square foot, a median year built of 2021 and a median strata fee of $406 a month.
